rules.prohibited: Direct explicit profanity, including abbreviations with clear profane meaning, interjections, self-directed swearing and blocked attempts. No exemption for friendship, jokes, frustration, no named victim or gameplay context.
rules.exceptions: Genuine moderation report or rule clarification quoting only what is needed; demonstrably accidental substring/typo. Do not invent educational context or an innocent expansion unsupported by the conversation.
rules.ambiguous: 고립된 약어의 의미가 실제로 불명확한 경우; 욕설 맥락의 ㅅㅂ은 위반

rules.prohibited: Intentional alteration representing language prohibited by any server speech rule: spacing, inserted symbols/digits, transliteration, initials or consecutive message fragments. A successful filter bypass or a previous block is not required.
rules.exceptions: Demonstrably ordinary abbreviation/typo/coincidence or rephrasing genuinely allowed text after a false positive. First establish the prohibited expression; do not exempt a recognizable alteration just because a theoretical innocent reading exists.
rules.violation: 시1발 너 / 응 ㄷㅣㅋㅋ (응디를 분리한 직접 사용)
rules.allowed: 독 45초로 변경했어요 → 필터 오탐 후 4'5초로 변경 / 님미안해의 단어 경계 오탐 후 사과를 다시 입력

rules.prohibited: Personal degradation, dehumanization, humiliation or exclusion directed at a player, even once and without profanity. Skill criticism becomes a violation when it attacks the person (사람새끼냐, 인간 쓰레기, 접고 꺼져).
rules.exceptions: Only isolated mild gameplay/match teasing without personal degradation; sarcasm alone is insufficient. Gameplay context is not a blanket exemption for personal attacks.
rules.ambiguous: 접어라 (구체적 발언은 있으나 경기 전술 주문인지 사람을 배제하는 말인지 맥락이 끊김)

rules.prohibited: Direct or clearly elliptical family insults, including 니애미/느금마 used as a taunt, sexual family insults and split-message equivalents. A full sentence, actual family identity or victim complaint is not required.
rules.exceptions: Ordinary non-insulting family discussion or genuine moderation reporting/rule clarification. Friendship, retaliation and claiming a joke do not exempt family insults.
rules.ambiguous: 니 엄마가 (문장이 끊겨 실제 용법 불명)

rules.prohibited: Discriminatory slurs and identity-based degradation, including disability/racial/sexuality terms used to insult a player. The player need not actually belong to the targeted group; gameplay metaphors and jokes do not exempt abuse.
rules.exceptions: Clearly non-degrading identity/accessibility discussion or genuine moderation reporting/rule clarification. A claimed joke or quotation around a slur aimed at a player is not exempt.

rules.prohibited: Sexual degradation, sexual violence/threats, unsolicited sexual comments aimed at a player or their family, including gaming metaphors such as 너 강간당했네. No explicit objection from the recipient is needed for clear sexual degradation.
rules.exceptions: Genuine moderation report or rule clarification; clearly non-harassing factual content without prohibited language under other rules. Do not assume friendship, consent or an educational purpose.

rules.prohibited: Repeated targeted ridicule, humiliation, pressure to leave or harassment across at least two distinct attributable messages when context establishes a pattern. Repetition can be abusive without profanity; do not assess each mild fragment in isolation. Profanity alone, however often repeated, is not this rule: it needs ridicule, humiliation, threats or pressure beyond the profanity itself.
rules.exceptions: One mild taunt or constructive gameplay criticism; necessary repeated tactical/buff calls; the same curse or rude gesture sent again and again with nothing more, which is a single R01/R02 finding. These do not exempt a demonstrated pattern of humiliation. An explicit request to stop is useful evidence, not a prerequisite.
rules.violation: 여러 메시지에 걸쳐 같은 사람을 집요하게 비하
rules.allowed: 복수하러 와라 / 음성 대신 strength·speed·팟 요청을 반복하는 팀 콜
rules.ambiguous: 여러 비하 발언이 있으나 같은 사람을 겨냥한 패턴인지 불명확

rules.prohibited: Explicit server ban on player-authored conversational use of: 노무현, 김대중, 노짱, 노쨩, 놈현, 응디, 부엉이바위, 봉하마을, 운지 (including 운지법), 중력절, 슨상님, 우흥, 노알라, 북딱, 흔드르라, 노곰마. Political, historical, geographical, dialect or technical framing does NOT exempt these named expressions. This is a server vocabulary restriction: no malicious intent, insult, deceased mockery or affiliation proof is required. Also covers clearly abusive Ilbe-style usage.
rules.exceptions: Only genuine moderation reporting or necessary rule clarification quoting the expression. Not accidental character overlap or a player-controlled name merely appearing as metadata. Quotation marks, a factual topic or calling it educational do not alone exempt direct use. Resolve genuine uncertainty about reporting purpose through review.
rules.violation: 응디ㅋㅋ / 피아노 운지법 연습 / 노무현·김대중 정책 이야기 / 봉하마을 위치 질문
rules.allowed: 응디라고 하면 제재인가요? / 저 사람이 우흥이라고 했어요 / 피아노 연습
rules.ambiguous: “응디” 이거 신고 (원발언 신고인지 직접 발화 뒤 신고를 빙자하는지 맥락 부족)

rules.prohibited: Mocking a deceased person or their death, including memes, celebration and indirect but clearly identified death jokes. No link to a specific community or proof of political intent is needed.
rules.exceptions: Genuine moderation report/rule clarification or non-mocking remembrance of a person not independently prohibited by R08. Evaluate R08 separately: absence of death mockery does not exempt banned vocabulary.
rules.ambiguous: 인용 목적 또는 누구의 죽음을 말하는지 실제로 불명확한 경우

rules.prohibited: Sentence-final ~노 used conversationally, including natural regional dialect; intent/affiliation irrelevant
rules.exceptions: Only genuine necessary rule clarification or moderation report quotations; accidental word/name containing 노 without ending function. Quotation marks, dialect, friendship, harmless subject and a post-hoc claim of joking do not exempt direct use.
rules.allowed: “뭐하노”라고 하면 제재인가요? / 저 사람이 “뭐하노”라고 했어요 / 피아노
rules.ambiguous: 뭐하노 (quotation purpose or grammatical function unclear)
